4279-6112-6273--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6112-6273--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant, Fumulus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fumulus ability, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2292-7690-8181--165.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature, causing you to scry 1
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

443-728-3249-5268--52.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
443-728-3249-5268--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Magus of the Bridge triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

339-677-1322-3899.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-6972-7936.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Dominion Saboteur that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4247-6972-7936.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As it enters, choose to have it copy a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it, so Dominion Saboteur will also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

4681-5170-6495-7918.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.

1170-2099-5131-6289--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2099-5131-6289--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Voyager Quickwelder.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

4772-5478-6441-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
4772-5478-6441-7824-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-804-1619-3504.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-804-1619-3504.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Mercurial Pretender and Sakashima the Impostor each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mercurial Pretender trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-804-1619-3504.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

341-1621-6867-6967.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

757-2085-3094.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

423-433-765-1437--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-433-765-1437--85.description:
Cast Llanowar Scout by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Llanowar Scout spell three times.
Resolve the first Llanowar Scout copy.
Activate the Llanowar Scout token by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

1894-2173-5220-7286.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2906-7182-7252.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 4 life this turn.
2906-7182-7252.description:
Cast Grave Sifter for its evoke cost by paying {0} due to Rakdos.
When Grave Sifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Grave Sifter.
When Grave Sifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Grave Sifter with haste.
When the Grave Sifter token enters, it triggers, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4908-4934-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Amareth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

104-1818-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1818-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1274-2086-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2530-2577-6518-6719.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
2530-2577-6518-6719.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Dazzling Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Dazzling Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

1594-2866-3689-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1879-3259-5734.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control other than Death Tyrant.
1879-3259-5734.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any creature you control except Death Tyrant, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Death Tyrant triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

708-997-2459-2500.description:
Pay {2} to Mirage Mirror to have it become a copy of Myth Unbound until end of turn.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Rograkh, returning Rograkh to the command zone.
When Rograkh enters the command zone, both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 2.

654-1541-2034-2493-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Archaeomancer, adding {C}{C}.
When Archaeomancer dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Archaeomancer on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Hit the Mother Lode by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}, exiling Archaeomancer from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, and creating six tapped Treasure artifact tokens.
When Archaeomancer and the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers six times and Archaeomancer triggers once.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Hit the Mother Lode from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1020-2034-2866-4947.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Thopter and Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {3}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

575-4050-4091.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Aphetto Alchemist, adding {U}.
When Aphetto Alchemist dies, Yedora triggers, returning Aphetto Alchemist from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

974-4499-4919.notablePrerequisites: There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-4499-4919.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Dutiful Replicator.
When Dutiful Replicator enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a copy of the Smaug token.
Put one of the Smaug tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target any other token you control using Dutiful Replicator's ability.

283-2364-3930.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Rimewind Taskmage.
Rimewind Taskmage does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four snow permanents.
283-2364-3930.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Rimewind Taskmage by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Rimewind Taskmage's ability, targeting Mana Vault.
Resolve both abilities, untapping Rimewind Taskmage and Mana Vault.
Repeat.

4050-4365-4385.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating two 1/1 Sliver creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Slivers, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1419-4659-5003.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Breya's Apprentice, adding {C}{C}.
Breya's Apprentice dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Breya's Apprentice from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Breya's Apprentice enters the battlefield, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1308-3423-4541.notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight Treasure tokens.
1308-3423-4541.description:
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {8}.
Cast Marut by paying {8}.
Marut enters the battlefield, creating sixteen Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{W}.
Activate Aegis Automaton by paying {4}{W}, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
